title: Failure-triage evaluation boundaries
description: Run from the checkout. Set TRIAGE_PROOF_OUT to a new directory. All transport fixtures are explicitly non-live and cannot enable the pilot.

proof.intent: Exercise the real evaluation CLI's offline, key, price, budget, timeout, rate-limit and response rejection paths; assert no live provider calls or eligible fixture results.

v2.intent: Prove admitted v2 selection, no reference/control data in serialized SDK input, no retries, live guards and correlated-family reporting without external transport.

pilot-evidence.intent: Validate the immutable pilot prerequisite through the real verifier CLI; reject absent, tampered and handwritten gates without provider calls.
